_comment_profiles: Two speakers, deliberately different voices so you can tell WHO is talking without looking. 'jarvis' is the Claude Code side narrating what it is ABOUT to do; 'revit' is the AJ Tools add-in confirming what Revit actually RETURNED. neural = an edge-tts voice (free, needs internet); fallback = a Windows SAPI voice that always exists offline. Run `voice list` to see every neural voice available.
_comment_maxWords: Ajmal asked for a SHORT reply in voice. Lines are trimmed to this many words before speaking, so a long summary never turns into a monologue you have to sit through.
_comment_idleExitSeconds: How long the speaking process stays warm after the queue empties. Importing the neural library costs ~1.4s, so staying warm is the difference between 1.1s and 2.7s per line. It exits on its own after this, so nothing is left running when you stop working.
_comment_neuralCooldownSeconds: When the neural voice fails (no internet), stop retrying it for this long and go straight to the offline Windows voice. Without this, every single line would sit waiting for a network timeout before falling back.
_comment_mute: Tool names that are never narrated. These are the bookkeeping calls that would otherwise talk over the actual work.
